plugins.name: dnd-characters
plugins.description: MCP server for managing Dungeons & Dragons characters: list, search, create, update and delete characters by name, class, species, level and alignment.

plugins.name: huit-search
plugins.description: MCP server for topic search over the Harvard University IT (HUIT) website, on Cloudflare Workers with Okta OAuth.

plugins.name: image-generator
plugins.description: MCP server that generates images with OpenAI's image model and returns a link to each image.

plugins.name: kagi-news
plugins.description: Daily news from Kagi News in four sections (World, Science, United States, Boston): list, read and search the day's stories.

plugins.name: micro-books
plugins.description: MCP server for managing Micro.blog book collections. Use these tools to manage bookshelves, add/remove books, and track reading goals.

plugins.name: selenography-lunar-features-server
plugins.description: MCP server for exploring lunar selenography data. Use these tools to search, filter, and analyze features on the Moon's surface including craters, maria, mountains, and more.

plugins.name: solar-system-api-server
plugins.description: MCP server for exploring solar system data. Use these tools to search, filter, and analyze celestial bodies including planets, moons, asteroids, and comets. You can also calculate real-time positions of objects from any observer location.
